AquacultureFishing.PondOrganismDef.label: duckweed
AquacultureFishing.PondOrganismDef.description: A rapidly spreading floating plant eaten by herbivorous and omnivorous fish.

AquacultureFishing.PondOrganismDef.label: sea lettuce
AquacultureFishing.PondOrganismDef.description: A salt-tolerant green alga that forms edible sheets and nursery cover.

AquacultureFishing.PondOrganismDef.label: daphnia
AquacultureFishing.PondOrganismDef.description: Minute freshwater crustaceans that graze algae and provide live prey for fry and small carnivores.

AquacultureFishing.PondOrganismDef.label: brine shrimp
AquacultureFishing.PondOrganismDef.description: Tiny salt-tolerant crustaceans that turn algae into live prey for marine and brackish fish.

AquacultureFishing.PondOrganismDef.label: pond snails
AquacultureFishing.PondOrganismDef.description: Small snails that graze detritus and become food for bottom-feeding and omnivorous fish.

AquacultureFishing.PondOrganismDef.label: freshwater mussels
AquacultureFishing.PondOrganismDef.description: Slow-growing freshwater filter-feeders that consume suspended algae and can support predators.

AquacultureFishing.PondOrganismDef.label: blue mussels
AquacultureFishing.PondOrganismDef.description: Marine filter-feeders that consume suspended algae and become prey for larger coastal fish.
